stories.title: Former Bishop of Aberdeen dies aged 91
stories.summary: The Diocese of Aberdeen announced that the Right Reverend Peter Moran had died on Friday at Northcote Lodge Care Home.

stories.title: Dundee University and UCU reach deal over redundancy proposals
stories.summary: It includes an enhanced voluntary redundancy scheme and avoiding compulsory redundancies "wherever possible".

stories.title: Man who killed woman after row over watch is jailed
stories.summary: Tony Grimes, 43, had been involved in an altercation with Patricia Irvine outside her home in Parkhead on 12 May 2024.

stories.title: Man dies after being seriously injured at Edinburgh film studio
stories.summary: Emergency crews were called to reports of an incident at FirstStage in Leith.

stories.title: Care home closure warning after inspectors raise serious concerns
stories.summary: Craigielea Care Home in Renfrew has been given until 15 December to make improvements or face losing its registration.

stories.title: Ayrshire charity wins funding to turn church into community hub
stories.summary: The South Parish Church in Girvan could become a community hub after receiving a six-figure funding award

stories.title: Glasgow's free transport pilot a success - but council cannot afford to widen it
stories.summary: Almost 1,000 people, aged between 22 and 59, were given unlimited travel on buses, ScotRail trains and the Subway for six weeks.

stories.title: Shoplifters using harpoon guns and machetes in targeted attacks, say shop staff
stories.summary: Retailers say they are facing rising levels of violence as reports of shoplifting rise dramatically.

stories.title: 'Culture of fear' putting NHS Grampian patients at risk, say health experts
stories.summary: Scotland's patient safety commissioner and the previous chairman of BMA Scotland made the remarks in the wake of a damning report about senior leadership failings in the health board.

stories.title: Police end 'active inquiry' into 1998 disappearance of Fife teenager
stories.summary: Kenneth Jones has never been found since vanishing from the family home in Glenrothes 28 years ago.

stories.title: £1m cocaine recovery after raids in Perthshire and Fife
stories.summary: Officers recovered 9kg of cocaine after searches of a car and house on Wednesday.

stories.title: Your pictures of Scotland
stories.summary: A selection of photographs submitted to BBC Scotland News from around the country this week.
